fixed_production_funnel.interpretation: The fixed B2R window proves complete current-mint routing and 17 strict production completion-retention-replay paths. Three terminal production jobs remain failures and are not retroactively reclassified.

isolated_provider_qualification.interpretation: The bounded isolated contract proves creator-funding evidence is obtainable for all 20 frozen members. It supplements but does not mutate the fixed production funnel.

closure_basis: 20/20 marked migrations reached Shared Acquisition under the fully loaded B2M marker path.
Every production completion in the fixed B2R window was retained and replayable.
The isolated oldest-transaction contract validated exact inbound native SOL funding lineage for 20/20 frozen members within its 60-request ceiling.
The request and projection ledgers reconcile exactly and both earlier failed runs remain sealed.
limitations: The B2R fixed production completion denominator remains 17/20; isolated provider qualification does not retroactively complete the three timed-out production jobs.
The oldest-transaction sentinel is qualified for this frozen 20-member cohort; it is not a universal historical-funding completeness guarantee.
The provider sample is small and uses a higher-cost Helius Enhanced request once per member.
Runtime Evidence authority, Evidence Mirror, and Cohort Mode remain inactive and unqualified for production activation in this closure milestone.
Sealed provider artifacts reside in isolated local temporary directories; this committed closure records their hashes and bounded aggregate conclusions, not raw provider payloads.
